title: Direct response video editor for 8-figure dtc brand
description: Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred) $1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1 M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale. Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, You Tube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly. What You'll Actually Do High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously. Master Direct Response Mechanics: Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches) Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, You Tube Shorts) A/B test visual approaches based on performance data Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Da Vinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced. Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here. AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation. Top Fits Will Have: Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement) 2+ years editing for DTC/e Commerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal) Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners) Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or Da Vinci Resolve + After Effects Deep understanding of Meta/You Tube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box) Bonus Points: Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes) Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4 D) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles Familiarity with Cap Cut, Descript, or AI editing tools Portuguese + English fluency Non-Negotiables: Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions) Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment Obsessive attention to detail Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback Why Top Editors Choose Us: Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base. Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within. See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't). ️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency. Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration. High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially. Application Process: Step 1: Submit Application Current CV/resume Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or You Tube unlisted) Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours. Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand. Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns. Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.

title: Técnico deck machinery iii
description: A pessoa atuará como Técnico de Manutenção, sendo responsável pela verificar as tarefas corretivas e preventivas, executar reparos e corrigir problemas de Downtime. Duas vagas disponíveis: Guaxindiba – São Gonçalo/RJ; Porto do Açu – São João da Barra/RJ. Responsabilidades e atribuições Executar serviços técnicos de manutenção de sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos e elétricos, envolvendo equipamentos de Deck Machinery, principalmente guinchos e guindastes; Verificar as tarefas corretivas e preventivas pendentes do programa de manutenção e atualizá-las com relatórios e comentários técnicos detalhados das tarefas correlacionadas; Examinar o estado e as funções dos equipamentos, as características de seu ambiente de operação, componentes estruturais, aparelhos e instalações relacionadas (hidráulica, pneumática, mecânicas, elétricas, etc.); Ler, interpretar e elaborar análises críticas de desenhos, esboços, tabelas, especificações técnicas, manuais ou instruções de equipamentos de todos os fabricantes; Identificar defeitos em equipamentos, participar do processo de investigação de falha, examinar as condições de operacionalidade e verificar a necessidade e a viabilidade da reparação; Inspecionar equipamentos, peças, conjuntos e elementos, registrando os dados e os resultados dos testes; Identificar e solicitar necessidades de materiais e serviços; Executar reparos, efetuando manutenções, vedações, ajustes, regulagens, testes de funcionamento, utilizando materiais, processos e instrumentos adequados; Monitorar testes de qualidade visando o pleno funcionamento esperado; Resolver e corrigir problemas de Downtime; Acompanhar e validar reparos a bordo, garantindo a correta execução e excelência técnica por parte das subcontratadas; Recomendar ajustes dos parâmetros de mínimo e máximo e de reposição do estoque dos ativos e materiais de reparo, incluindo itens críticos. Requisitos e qualificações Técnico em Hidráulica, Mecânica, Elétrica ou áreas afins com registro ativo no CFT; Inglês Avançado. Requisitos desejáveis Conhecimento básico em pacote Office, principalmente Word, Excel e Power Point; Conhecimento em processos de PCM aplicados à gestão e manutenção de equipamentos de Deck Machinery; Conhecimento em equipamentos hidráulicos, elétricos e pneumáticos relacionados à disciplina de Guinchos e Guindastes subsea em ambientes marítimos ou offshore; Conhecimento em metrologia, desenho técnico, testes e ensaios; Habilidade para interpretar e trabalhar com manuais técnicos, esquemas hidráulicos, elétricos e mecânicos fornecidos pelos fabricantes.

title: Customer support geoscientist
description: Position Summary You will join Bluware, a wholly owned subsidiary of CMG (Computer Modelling Group) in Brazil as a dedicated resource supporting Petrobras, working at the intersection of technical support, geophysics, and client engagement, as part of Bluware's Customer Support Team. Your primary responsibility will be to provide in-person and remote support for Interactiv AI in close collaboration with the broader support and technical teams. This role involves assisting users with their workflows and ensuring a high standard of customer experience and satisfaction. Your core support responsibilities will focus on helping customers apply AI-assisted seismic interpretation workflows using Interactiv AI. For this reason, a strong foundation in seismic interpretation is essential. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, combined with a customer-focused mindset, are important. You will also work closely with the technical lead and the clients to assist in understanding customer needs, support the development of case studies, and contribute to initiatives aimed at increasing software adoption and improving product performance. The feedback and insights gathered through these activities will contribute to the continuous improvement of Interactiv AI and to Bluware's broader development efforts in Brazil. Success in this position will require you to develop and maintain a deep understanding of Bluware's technology and its applications. Bluware will provide the necessary software and domain training to help you reach the required level of expertise quickly and continue developing in the role. Key Responsibilities Provide timely and effective on-site and remote support to the client, as well as diagnose and resolve software-related issues. Work closely with the Technical Leader to support customer engagements, user training sessions, and participate in technical consulting activities. Identify and analyze software issues, escalating to support team or product team when necessary. Ensure issues are fully documented, tracked, and communicated clearly to clients. Gather user feedback and identify recurring issues or improvement opportunities. Note: This description reflects the general nature of the role. It's not a complete list of responsibilities—we believe in flexibility, initiative, and growing together. Required Qualifications Graduated in Geophysics or Geology. Good grounding in 2 D and 3 D seismic interpretation, including experience with horizon and fault interpretation, seismic attributes, and familiarity with well ties, stratigraphy, and basin analysis. At least 3 years of experience in seismic interpretation projects (industry or academia), including hands-on experience developing case studies from interpretation work. Strong problem-solving skills. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to work directly with clients. Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams. Fluent in Portuguese and English (spoken and written), with strong communication skills for technical discussions. Based in Rio de Janeiro, with authorization to work in Brazil. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience in a client-facing or support role. Master's or Ph D in Geophysics or Geology with focus on seismic interpretation projects is a plus. Exposure to seismic interpretation projects with O&G companies. Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus. Knowledge about AI is a plus. Key Skills Client relationship management and customer satisfaction Seismic interpretation expertise (2 D & 3 D) Consultative, service-oriented communication Training delivery and technical consulting Problem solving and troubleshooting Cross-functional collaboration Issue documentation and case study development Scope of Support The role focuses on: Providing on-site and remote support for Interactiv AI. Assisting customers with AI-assisted seismic interpretation workflows. Supporting user training sessions and technical consulting activities. Interpreting seismic data and developing case studies that demonstrate Interactiv AI's value and support software adoption. Gathering client feedback to support continuous product improvement.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description: Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads. Key Responsibilities 1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Professor de educação física
description: Job overview We are looking for an experienced and qualified Physical Education teacher to join our Primary Section P. E Department at our Botafogo Site. We are seeking a dedicated educator to focus initially on teaching UK Key Stages 1 and 2, promoting sportsmanship, teamwork, and students’ overall well-being. Responsibilities Child Psychomotor Development: A deep understanding of body schemes, laterality, balance, and gross motor coordination for children aged 2 to 11 mainly. International Curricula and Methodologies: Familiarity with frameworks such as the EYFS (Early Years Foundation Stage) from the British curriculum Familiarity in international curricula like the IPC (International Primary Curriculum), Cambridge Primary / International Baccalaureate (IB). Understanding the Transition from Early Years to Key Stage 1 / Primary A child-centered and play-based learning approach through movement and active games. Differentiation and Inclusion: Ability to design activity stations that accommodate different physical maturity levels. Introduction to Basic Game Rules & Sports Literacy: Ability to teach simplified versions of team sports (mainly volleyball, basketball, futsal and handball), cooperative games, gymnastics, track & field (athletics), and rhythm and movement. Spatial & Tactical Awareness: Teaching children how to share space, understand boundaries, play offense/defense in simple games, and follow rules safely. First Aid & CPR: Practically mandatory in international schools to manage safety during physical activities with young children. Child Protection & Safeguarding Training: A standard required certification across schools with British or American international curricula. Energy, Patience, and Empathy: Ability to lead high-energy classes while maintaining a safe, welcoming, and dynamic environment. Classroom Management in Open Spaces: Skill in keeping group attention and maintaining discipline through clear rules in gymnasiums or outdoors. Intercultural Sensitivity: Ability to work effectively with families and students from diverse nationalities and cultural backgrounds. Encouraging Sportsmanship & Teamwork: Guiding children through winning and losing gracefully, resolving minor conflict, and encouraging inclusive play. Formal Progress Tracking & Reporting: Experience with assessing movement competency, tracking individual progress against curriculum standards, and writing formal student reports for parents. Behavior Management: Ability to maintain structure and focus in larger spaces (gyms/fields) using clear routines, time-management techniques, and positive reinforcement for students. Key Requirements A degree and a teaching qualification in Physical Education (Licenciatura)Active registration - CREF. Fluency in English (C1 level)The candidate must reside in Brazil. Secure subject knowledge in Physical Education. Proven ability to teach UK Key Stages 1 and 2 effectively. Experience working in a school setting.

Registrar e acompanhar as tratativas por meio de sistema interno, garantindo a atualização das informações. Experiência prévia com o uso de IA - Inteligência Artificial no ambiente jurídico.

Dar suporte no desenvolvimento e na implementação de programas de treinamento e liderança. We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale. Responsibilities Creative Strategy Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels Performance & Media Buying Integration Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction. Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads AI & Creative Innovation Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing. Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads). Qualifications Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing. Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred. Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads). Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Working hours 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday) Fully-remote Compensation $3,500 to $5,000/month If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Sales assistant

title: Sr. workday financials consultant
description: Senior Workday Financials Consultant About the Role Aspire is looking for a Senior Workday Financials Consultant to join our Finance Solution Delivery team on a contract basis. In this role, you will serve as a versatile Workday Financials subject matter expert , supporting production operations, system enhancements, and strategic Finance transformation initiatives. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized. Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions. Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities. Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health. Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements. Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities. Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs. Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U. S. time zones. Required Qualifications 8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience. Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday. Proven experience supporting both production environments and project-based initiatives. Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills. Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains. Priority Workday Financials Areas Highest Priority Financial Accounting Expenses Business Assets Secondary Priority Banking & Settlement Nice to Have VNDLY experience Lower Priority Procurement experience — the organization is gradually phasing this area out. What Success Looks Like In this role, success means you: Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities. Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders. Deliver scalable, maintainable solutions rather than short-term fixes. Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption. Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team. Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives. Why Aspire? Join a Remote-First organization. Work alongside exceptional technology professionals from around the world. Access continuous technical and professional development opportunities. Gain international exposure by collaborating with global technology leaders. Receive nursery reimbursement benefits. Participate in virtual and onsite international technology conferences. Work within an IT environment aligned with rigorous security and compliance standards, including ISO and SOC frameworks.

Ministrar treinamentos presenciais e virtuais para equipes operacionais, comerciais e lideranças da rede de concessionárias. Traduzir conceitos técnicos e estratégicos em conteúdos claros, aplicáveis e alinhados à realidade do negócio. Desenvolver treinamentos voltados para processos de pós-vendas, peças, serviços, atendimento ao cliente, vendas e rentabilidade. Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências de liderança, gestão de equipes e melhoria de resultados. Experiência em concessionárias automotivas, especialmente nas áreas de Peças, Oficina, Serviços e Atendimento ao Cliente. Conhecimento dos processos de compras e vendas de peças, varejo e atacado. Vivência na condução de treinamentos e desenvolvimento de conteúdo para equipes operacionais e lideranças. Habilidade para facilitar treinamentos e promover aprendizagem de forma prática e engajadora. Capacidade de conectar aspectos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para gerar impacto no desempenho das equipes. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita. Disponibilidade para viagens. Diferenciais Experiência com treinamento corporativo no segmento automotivo. Vivência em programas de desenvolvimento de lideranças. Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem Experiência na utilização de plataformas de aprendizagem e ferramentas digitais de treinamento. Competências Comportamentais Comunicação e influência. Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal. Protagonismo e senso de dono. Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos. Pensamento analítico e visão de negócio. Colaboração e trabalho em equipe. Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade. Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset). title: Clinical & marketing specialist

Since its establishment over a decade ago, the company has grown to a large scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide. title: Customer support geoscientist
description: Position Summary You will join Bluware, a wholly owned subsidiary of CMG (Computer Modelling Group) in Brazil as a dedicated resource supporting Petrobras, working at the intersection of technical support, geophysics, and client engagement, as part of Bluware’s Customer Support Team. Your primary responsibility will be to provide in-person and remote support for Interactiv AI in close collaboration with the broader support and technical teams. This role involves assisting users with their workflows and ensuring a high standard of customer experience and satisfaction. Your core support responsibilities will focus on helping customers apply AI-assisted seismic interpretation workflows using Interactiv AI. For this reason, a strong foundation in seismic interpretation is essential. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, combined with a customer-focused mindset, are important. You will also work closely with the technical lead and the clients to assist in understanding customer needs, support the development of case studies, and contribute to initiatives aimed at increasing software adoption and improving product performance. The feedback and insights gathered through these activities will contribute to the continuous improvement of Interactiv AI and to Bluware’s broader development efforts in Brazil. Success in this position will require you to develop and maintain a deep understanding of Bluware’s technology and its applications. Bluware will provide the necessary software and domain training to help you reach the required level of expertise quickly and continue developing in the role. Key Responsibilities Provide timely and effective on-site and remote support to the client, as well as diagnose and resolve software-related issues. Work closely with the Technical Leader to support customer engagements, user training sessions, and participate in technical consulting activities. Identify and analyze software issues, escalating to support team or product team when necessary. Ensure issues are fully documented, tracked, and communicated clearly to clients. Gather user feedback and identify recurring issues or improvement opportunities. Note: This description reflects the general nature of the role. It’s not a complete list of responsibilities—we believe in flexibility, initiative, and growing together. Required Qualifications Graduated in Geophysics or Geology. Good grounding in 2 D and 3 D seismic interpretation, including experience with horizon and fault interpretation, seismic attributes, and familiarity with well ties, stratigraphy, and basin analysis. At least 3 years of experience in seismic interpretation projects (industry or academia), including hands-on experience developing case studies from interpretation work. Strong problem-solving skills. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to work directly with clients. Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams. Fluent in Portuguese and English (spoken and written), with strong communication skills for technical discussions. Based in Rio de Janeiro, with authorization to work in Brazil. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience in a client-facing or support role. Master’s or Ph D in Geophysics or Geology with focus on seismic interpretation projects is a plus. Exposure to seismic interpretation projects with O& G companies. Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus. Knowledge about AI is a plus. Key Skills Client relationship management and customer satisfaction Seismic interpretation expertise (2 D & 3 D) Consultative, service-oriented communication Training delivery and technical consulting Problem solving and troubleshooting Cross-functional collaboration Issue documentation and case study development Scope of Support The role focuses on: Providing on-site and remote support for Interactiv AI. Assisting customers with AI-assisted seismic interpretation workflows. Supporting user training sessions and technical consulting activities. Interpreting seismic data and developing case studies that demonstrate Interactiv AI’s value and support software adoption. Gathering client feedback to support continuous product improvement.

title: Strategy & operations manager

They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth. We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart. The Role Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA. What You'll Bring 5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Supervisor(a) de sell out (beauty)
description: A SMART BEAUTY , filial brasileira do Diffugroup , grupo com mais de 40 anos de atuação na América Latina e responsável pela gestão de mais de 60 marcas internacionais de fragrâncias e cosméticos premium, segue em forte expansão no Brasil e busca um(a) Supervisor(a) de Sell Out . Nosso portfólio reúne algumas das marcas mais desejadas do mundo, como Dolce & Gabbana, Versace, Moschino, Michael Kors, Moroccanoil, Pupa Milano, Clean Beauty, Atkinsons e Brunello Cucinelli , entre outras. Sobre a posição O(a) Supervisor(a) de Sell Out será responsável por garantir a excelência na execução das estratégias comerciais e de marca nos principais clientes do Mercado Local, impulsionando o crescimento do Sell-out e proporcionando uma experiência diferenciada ao consumidor por meio da gestão eficiente das equipes de vendas, da execução nos pontos de venda, dos treinamentos, das ações promocionais e dos lançamentos. Também será responsável por acompanhar a performance do negócio e das equipes em campo, assegurar a correta implementação das estratégias nos pontos de venda, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolver planos de ação para maximizar resultados, atuando em estreita colaboração com as áreas Comercial, Marketing e Trade Marketing. Principais responsabilidades • Gerenciar e desenvolver as equipes de vendas (Beauty Advisors/Consultores de Beleza) sob sua responsabilidade, definindo e acompanhando metas de Sell-out, performance individual, escalas, integração de novos colaboradores, motivação e desenvolvimento da equipe. • Garantir a excelência na execução nos pontos de venda por meio de visitas regulares às lojas, acompanhando merchandising, materiais de POS, mobiliário, preços, estoque, testers, espaços permanentes e secundários, assegurando a correta implementação dos guidelines das marcas. • Planejar e coordenar treinamentos, coaching e ações de desenvolvimento para as equipes próprias e dos varejistas, garantindo conhecimento de produto, excelência no atendimento e alinhamento com as estratégias das marcas. • Coordenar a implementação e o acompanhamento de animações, promoções, incentivos e demais ações de Sell-out, assegurando a correta execução das mecânicas, a comunicação das metas, a gestão das equipes temporárias e a avaliação dos resultados. • Garantir a correta execução dos lançamentos e do sortimento nos pontos de venda, acompanhando disponibilidade, preços, estoque, performance e atividade da concorrência, além de identificar oportunidades e compartilhar feedbacks de mercado com as áreas Comercial, Marketing e Trade Marketing. Indicadores-chave de sucesso • Sell-out : atingimento das metas de vendas por cliente, loja, marca e equipe. • Crescimento do negócio: evolução do Sell-out versus ano anterior e versus objetivos definidos. • Performance da equipe: atingimento das metas individuais e produtividade das equipes de vendas. • Disponibilidade de estoque (Stock Availability): manutenção de níveis adequados de estoque e identificação preventiva de riscos de ruptura. • Execução no ponto de venda (POS): cumprimento dos guidelines de merchandising, precificação, testers, materiais de comunicação, espaços e imagem das marcas. • Performance de ativações e animações: atingimento dos objetivos comerciais e correta execução das ações planejadas. • Execução de lançamentos: implementação dos lançamentos dentro dos prazos e padrões estabelecidos pelas marcas. • Treinamentos: cumprimento do calendário de treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo das equipes de vendas. Requisitos • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência nas áreas de Vendas, Retail, Trade Marketing ou funções correlatas, preferencialmente no setor de Beauty, Perfumes e Cosméticos. • Experiência em gestão e acompanhamento de equipes de vendas em campo. • Conhecimento da dinâmica do varejo de Beauty e da execução em pontos de venda. • Experiência com implementação de lançamentos, ações promocionais, ativações de marca e treinamentos no ponto de venda. • Experiência com Sephora será considerada um diferencial relevante. • Experiência com outros varejistas de Beauty, Perfumaria, Department Stores ou canais relacionados será considerada um diferencial. • Experiência no segmento de Luxo ou Prestige será considerada um diferencial. Competências comportamentais • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal. • Liderança e capacidade de gestão, desenvolvimento e engajamento de equipes, incluindo definição de objetivos, acompanhamento de performance, feedback e coaching. • Forte capacidade de trabalho em equipe e colaboração com diferentes áreas, especialmente Vendas, Trade Marketing e Marketing. • Organização, gestão do tempo e habilidade para priorizar demandas em ambientes dinâmicos. • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de identificar oportunidades, propor soluções e apoiar a tomada de decisões. • Proatividade, senso de urgência e forte orientação para resultados. • Capacidade de execução com foco na excelência operacional e na implementação de estratégias no ponto de venda. • Visão estratégica de negócio, com entendimento dos objetivos comerciais e das oportunidades de crescimento. • Criatividade, flexibilidade e habilidade para atuar em ambientes de constante transformação. • Atenção aos detalhes e foco na experiência do consumidor. Conhecimentos técnicos • Excel e Power Point em nível intermediário ou avançado. • Inglês intermediário a avançado. Diferenciais • Experiência no setor de Luxo, Beauty, Perfumes e Cosméticos. • Vivência em fragrâncias, cosméticos, skincare ou maquiagem. Outros requisitos • Disponibilidade para viagens e deslocamentos frequentes para acompanhamento dos pontos de venda. Se você é apaixonado(a) pelo universo de beleza e luxo, tem forte orientação para resultados e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa em pleno crescimento, queremos conhecer você. Candidate-se e venha construir essa história com a SMART BEAUTY.

title: Analista fp&a - sênior
description: Sobre a Bloquo A Bloquo atua na construção de infraestrutura financeira para operações envolvendo ativos digitais, pagamentos internacionais e serviços financeiros . A posição terá atuação próxima à liderança e às áreas do negócio, com foco em planejamento, análise de resultados, projeções e construção de cenários . Requisitos Formação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; 4–6+ anos de experiência em FP&A, Planejamento Financeiro, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas; Sólido conhecimento de P&L/DRE, fluxo de caixa, indicadores financeiros e análise de resultados; Experiência com budget, forecast e análise de variações; Domínio de modelagem financeira e construção de cenários; Excel avançado; Forte capacidade analítica e de interpretação de dados; Boa comunicação, com clareza e objetividade ao apresentar análises para diferentes públicos; Perfil analítico, organizado, curioso e orientado a resultados, com autonomia para conduzir suas entregas. Diferenciais Experiência em fintechs, instituições financeiras, empresas de pagamentos ou ativos virtuais; Experiência em ambientes regulados e/ou com o Banco Central; Conhecimento de operações com criptoativos e stablecoins; Conhecimento de Power BI, Power Query e/ou SQL; Experiência com análise de viabilidade e valuation de iniciativas; Inglês avançado; Conhecimento de operações internacionais. O que oferecemos Swile Multibenefícios ; Gympass , incentivando saúde e bem-estar; Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para desenvolvimento ; Atuação próxima à liderança e exposição a diferentes áreas do negócio; Oportunidade de trabalhar com ativos digitais, infraestrutura financeira e operações internacionais ; Possibilidade de participar ativamente da construção e evolução dos processos financeiros da companhia . title: Advogado(a) pleno(a)/sênior

Key Responsibilities Operate pedestal cranes in accordance with established procedures, operating limits, and safety requirements; Drive pedestal cranes during ship-to-ship and inboard lifting operations; Operate electro-mechanical lifting equipment, excluding pedestal cranes; Inspect lifting gear regularly and prior to the commencement of lifting operations; Perform predictive and routine maintenance activities related to pedestal cranes in accordance with procedures and CMMS work orders; Communicate effectively with riggers, signal persons, and site supervisors to coordinate lifting operations safely and efficiently; Monitor lifting operations and ensure compliance with applicable procedures and safety requirements; Respond appropriately to emergency situations and participate in emergency response activities as required; Perform routine maintenance activities and promptly report mechanical, operational, or safety-related issues; Maintain accuraterecords of crane operations, maintenance activities, inspections, and relevant equipment conditions; Ensure compliancewith onboard safety procedures, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements; Maintain a strongsafety-focused approach throughout all lifting and crane operations. Requirements Valid Crane Operator certification/licence applicable to offshore lifting operations; Previous experience operating pedestal cranes in offshore, FPSO, maritime, or oil & gas environments; Demonstrated experience with ship-to-ship and inboard lifting operations; Knowledge of lifting equipment, lifting gear, and safe lifting practices; Familiarity with crane inspection, maintenance, and CMMS work orders; Ability to communicate effectively with riggers, signal persons, and supervisors during lifting operations; Knowledge of offshore safety procedures and emergency response requirements; Basic to intermediate English communication skills; Strong teamwork, communication, discipline, and safety-oriented mindset; Ability to work effectively in an offshore environment and follow established procedures and operating limits. Benefits Meal and food allowances Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay) Life Insurance Annual Bonus Private Pension Plan Childcare Allowance Note This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens. title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você . Necessário: Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente
